title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
authors: Daojie Peng; Fulong Ma; Bingtao Wang; Sheng Wang; Jun Ma
hardware_evaluated: RTX 5080 edge workstation; RTX 4090 cloud server
metrics: task success; delay AUC; retention; hidden/action drift
edge_cloud_mechanism: stale learned cloud features plus current local vision
orin_thor_relevance: moderate: direct edge/cloud VLA but no Orin/Thor
key_claim: Paired current/delayed supervision yields strong LIBERO robustness through a 40-step delay window
limitations: Missing several training hyperparameters; small real-robot pilot; workstation-class edge; no embedded power/latency benchmark
notes: Direct evidence from uploaded v1 PDF
